Location: FKiSS Actions > valuepool

Action: valuepool(pool)

Related Actions: savevalue, loadvalue, deletevalue
See also: FKiSS, Value Pools, Events, Actions

valuepool(pool)

First defined in: FKiSS4
The valuepool action sets the current value pool where data will be saved, loaded, or deleted.
For more information, see Value Pools.

pool

pool is the name of the value pool. Value Pool names may be between 1 and 64 characters. They may contain letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores. Value Pool names are case-insensitive. The name must be enclosed with quotation marks.
To use the private pool, use "".

Example:

;@ valuepool("MyPublicData") ; uses the value pool named "MyPublicData".
;@ valuepool("")             ; uses the private value pool.
